aspect: Institutions act first and ask later
description: A name match triggers a hold, a review or a closure, because the cost of a wrong freeze falls on the customer and the cost of a missed match falls on the institution.
energy_note: Account frozen for a name you share with a stranger.

aspect: There is no central register to be cleared from
description: No certificate of innocence exists to present. Each institution repeats the process independently, indefinitely.
energy_note: Proving it again, at every new institution, forever.

aspect: Common names carry the most exposure
description: The most ordinary names in the population are the most likely to collide, so being unremarkable is itself the risk factor.
energy_note: Penalised for having a common name.

description: There are a great many Chukwuemeka Okaforso. His transfer is held for review for nineteen days. The bank will not say why and is not permitted to. The landlord does not accept nineteen days as an explanation.
energy_note: Nineteen days, for a name thousands of people have.
